title: Egg-shaped tall white craft using Dog Bone Lake as a landing field
place_text: North end of Indian Springs Valley / Dog Bone Lake, Nevada

tellings.quote: their base at the north end of Indian uh at Indian Springs, they were using Dog Bone Lake as their landing field.

plain: Between 1965 and 1967, egg-shaped craft flown by tall, white-skinned beings he calls the Tall Whites were landing on Dog Bone Lake, a dry lake bed at the north end of Indian Springs Valley in Nevada, according to Charles Hall, a man who says he spent three years around these beings near Area 51, a secret Air Force test site. Hall tells Michels that from 'their base at the north end of Indian Springs, they were using Dog Bone Lake as their landing field', which, if true, would put aliens working openly beside a US military base.
